audio.decoder: Electron Web Audio decodeAudioData from original frozen audio

officialParityGate.resampling: soundfile float32, mono mean, soxr 0.5.0.post1 HQ to 22050 Hz

timeMapping.derivation: 15-frame front pad and 15-frame trim at each window edge; retained frame zero is original sample zero and each window advances 142 frames

methods.full: Frozen v558 adjacent-frame spectral-flux candidate residuals
methods.neuralMax: Maximum of 88 onset activations per frame; strict local maximum; activation >=0.5; parabolic subframe interpolation
methods.neuralPitch: scipy.signal.argrelmax independently along each of 88 onset tracks; activation >=0.5; deduplicate frame times; no interpolation

candidateMatching: Nearest neural peak within +/-10 ms around reference + frozen globalDelay + frozen actual cross-fit top2/DP phase; full residual copied from v558

hypotheses.H1: At least one neural onset representation improves clear+approximate recall over full without reducing precision
hypotheses.H2: A neural onset representation can reduce no_clear candidate output rate without losing more clear+approximate recall
hypotheses.H3: Direct retained-frame coordinates and official tensor parity can be validated independently before real-song candidates are revealed

testPolicy: No threshold, timing offset, phase, or feature retuning after real-song metrics are revealed; any change requires a new version and independent confirmation set
